failure_observed: Static review of the skill against its goal (one workflow that takes a project repository to a complete, verified paper) found five capability gaps. Literature is specified but has no search or verification tooling, so the model does it by hand. No gate checks a citation against an index. Nothing outside the AUTHOR checks the draft for AI-specific research failures before review. Review is a single reader with no adversarial critique, and revision has no path for real reviewer comments. There is no formatted output. No empirical reader or user failure is claimed.

metrics.evidence_type: five inspected capability gaps in the v0.4.0 skill and tools, not five projects or user trials
locations: workflow.md step 7 and citation_rules.md section 2: citation checks described, no tool performs them
citation_rules.md row 8: retraction checked only when tools allow
workflow.md phases 3 to 4: no independent check between drafting and review
workflow.md steps 18 to 20: one reviewer role; no external-review path
workflow.md step 21: the skill stops at Markdown
metrics.design_source: Academic Research Skills, commit a41f3b2 (docs/SOURCES.md S32). Design only; nothing copied.

change.summary: Unify RCE with the capabilities of Academic Research Skills as one ordered workflow, with RCE as the spine: 8 phases and 22 steps, 12 modes, new gates GL (citations) and GI (integrity), a VERIFIER role, a 5-seat review panel, an external-review path, and a finalize phase. The revision cap falls from 3 rounds to 2 loops. Stage A delivered the documents and contracts. Stage B delivered the tools (tools/lit_search.py, verify_citations.py, integrity_check.py, format_paper.py, disclosure.py, rce_index.py) and wired GL and GI into the validator, the gate runner, the CLI and the role ledger. Stage C delivered the schemas, the VERIFIER, panel and coach prompts, the panel, rebut and verify roles in tools/rce_roles.py, tools/panel_check.py with G4 coverage of the panel, and the adapters. Stage D delivered the integrity benchmark (perturbation variants H to L), failure cases FC-0019 to FC-0033 with replay fixtures, and an end-to-end paper-mode run on a copy of the demo project (evaluation/unified_e2e/REPORT.md); the eight tool defects that run found are fixed.

expected_improvement: Fewer unverified or fabricated citations and fewer AI-specific integrity failures reaching review, plus a complete path from repository to formatted paper. None of this is measured yet. Reader comprehension benefit is not claimed.
possible_regressions: Longer SKILL.md and more linked files raise the risk that a model loads less of the skill than it needs; the load-bearing rules stay inline for that reason.
New gates and panel rounds add cost and round trips; step 0.3 states the worst case before the run.
Step renumbering invalidates step references in older logs and case files; workflow.md carries a mapping table, and historical records are left unchanged.
The revision cap falls from 3 rounds to 2 loops, so some defects that a third round would have fixed go to open_issues.md instead.
Until the later stages land, the documents describe tools that do not exist yet; a missing tool must record its gate as unverified, never passed.

Stage B: live smoke checks against Crossref, OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, arXiv and the DOI resolver on planted sources, recorded in docs/plans/UNIFIED_WORKFLOW_HANDOFF.md section 9 (manual, not in CI)
Stage C: T-094 to T-104 in tools/tests/test_v050_roles.py (41 tests, models mocked): schemas, the panel and VERIFIER roles, panel_check, G4 with a panel

Stage D: failure cases FC-0019 to FC-0033, replay fixtures CIT-01 to CIT-08, INT-01, INT-02 and INT-02b, and a regression test for each defect the end-to-end run found
Stage D: end-to-end paper-mode run on a copy of the demo project, with live index lookups, subagent roles and real Pandoc and LaTeX (evaluation/unified_e2e/REPORT.md; manual, not in CI)

results.scope: Stages A to D: documents, contracts, tools, schemas, prompts, adapters, the integrity benchmark and one end-to-end run on the synthetic demo project. The release decision is not made yet.
results.end_to_end: evaluation/unified_e2e/REPORT.md: every phase ran; GL, G1, G3 and G4 passed; GI and G5 failed as they should (open integrity checkpoints and markers). Not run: the final VERIFIER pass, panel round 2, the devil's-advocate rebuttal, the COACH.
results.version_note: SKILL.md keeps version 0.4.0 until the release step (versions/README.md); 0.5.0 is this proposal's target. Under the changelog's own policy a workflow change would be MAJOR; the user chose the next minor version on 2026-11-02.
